name: Hidaka Hokuto
source:
The child of an active idol and a famous actress. Hokuto is brave and collected, but is also an airhead due to his upbringing. With a resounding, powerful voice, he delivers energetic performances.

The leader of STARMAKER PRODUCTION's Trickstar.

[From in-game profile]
